evals.name: stub-array-fill-testcases
evals.prompt: I have an array-sum problem at evals/fixtures/eval-1-stub-array/. The spec.cpp has the input/output format and constraints set up, but TestCases() is empty. solution.cpp is provided and correct. Fill in TestCases() with a strong set of test cases that covers edge cases properly, then run tcframe to confirm every case generates successfully. Modify only spec.cpp.
evals.expected_output: spec.cpp with 8+ CASE() calls covering: N=1, N=MAXN, all-same values, sorted/reverse, random. Running drive.sh in the package exits 0 with 'ALL OK'.

assertions.text: running ./runner exits 0 with no FAILED cases
TestCases() contains at least 8 CASE() invocations
at least one case has N = 1
at least one case has N = MAXN (or equivalent literal 100000)
at least one case uses MAXV / 1000000000 as an element value
at least one non-random structural case (sorted, all-same, reverse, etc.) — not just rnd.nextInt
at least one case uses rnd.nextInt for variety

evals.name: subtask-and-test-groups
evals.prompt: The problem at evals/fixtures/eval-3-subtask-design/ has 3 subtasks per the statement, but the spec uses a flat Constraints()/TestCases() layout. Refactor spec.cpp to use SubtaskX() with Points() and TestGroupX() with proper Subtasks({...}) assignments. Design test groups by the Venn-diagram rule (one group per closed region). Then run tcframe to confirm everything passes. solution.cpp is correct — do not modify it.
evals.expected_output: spec.cpp now has Subtask1/2/3 with Points(20/30/50), and TestGroup1/2/3 with Subtasks({1,2,3}), ({2,3}), ({3}) respectively (or another valid Venn-region split). drive.sh exits 0.

assertions.text: running ./runner exits 0 with no FAILED cases
Points(20), Points(30), Points(50) (or equivalent — must sum to 100)
TestCases() is gone; TestGroup1/2/3 are used instead
TestGroup assignments follow Venn rule — e.g. TestGroup3 (largest cases) has Subtasks({3}) and its cases violate Subtasks 1/2 constraints
